brief: A raised bed of two bins that drain, both filled with soil.

requirements.evidence: 2 pieces at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0 with risers underneath (riser:0,0,0, riser:1,0,0)
fillSoil applied to both bins; check_build ok, meshClash clear

finish.summary: Two-cell raised bed: two bases on risers, each with a full drain bin filled with soil. Capped, locked, checks clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: A draining double bed coming up — I'll set two soil-filled bins on a raised stand.

result.note: Each family shows its first 6 offers; offers are valid until the next change.

warnings.message: 1 part(s) could slide apart (1 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: Both bins drain properly — now I'll seal, bolt, and fill them with soil.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.

events.text: Structure verified — I'll take a final overhead view of the soil.

calls.name: finish
